description: This file defines the SMTP class within the Opencart system library, providing functionality to send emails via SMTP protocol, including connection setup, message composition, and transmission.

classes.name: Smtp
classes.description: Class providing SMTP email sending capabilities, including connection handling, message preparation, authentication, and transmission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SMTP object with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text email message.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and sends the email over SMTP, handling connection, authentication, messaging, and server responses.

methods.name: handleReply
methods.description: Handles SMTP server replies, checking response codes and retries if necessary.
